description: Updates an existing payment record's editable fields.

body.paymentMode: enum, optional - CASH | CARD | UPI | NET_BANKING | CHEQUE | WALLET | CORPORATE_CREDIT
body.paymentStatus: enum, optional - SUCCESS | PENDING | FAILED | PARTIAL

validation: paymentMode, if provided, must reference a code in payment_mode_master
paymentStatus, if provided, must be one of SUCCESS, PENDING, FAILED, PARTIAL (CHECK)

errors.condition: Invalid paymentMode, amountPaid, or paymentStatus value

notes: database/api_contracts_test/015_payment.sql's API-T118 update targets rows by transaction_reference = 'TXN0001' scoped to organization/branch, and the API Test Results sheet records this as 'UPDATE 2 — multiple rows updated' marked DB GAP. This is a direct consequence of the missing UNIQUE constraint on transaction_reference (see API-057/API-064's database_gap) - because transaction_reference is not unique, filtering an update by it can match more than one payment row. This endpoint should be addressed/updated by paymentId (the primary key) rather than by transaction_reference to avoid the ambiguity; the test script's use of transaction_reference for targeting is what surfaced the gap, not the endpoint's own path parameter (which is already paymentId).
